body.x: A lot of music production is repetitive knob-turning that stands between an idea and the finished track. Letting a producer describe a change in words, and keeping the final call in their hands, speeds the tedious part without taking over.
Mixroom Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence and Content & Entertainment at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Mixroom, an AI co-producer DAW.

Mixroom is a professional digital audio workstation (DAW) powered by a proprietary AI model that helps creators edit, mix and refine their work through natural language. Its AI Co-Producer interprets creative intent in the context of the project and translates instructions into concrete actions, from adjusting track levels and effects to coordinating edits across multiple tracks.

Every AI action takes place within the DAW, where creators can inspect, modify or undo the changes, so by automating repetitive production tasks while helping users shape their sound, Mixroom keeps creative decisions in human hands.

Built to support the production process rather than generate finished songs, it combines intelligent audio assistance with a cross-platform professional audio engine and collaborative features for musicians, producers and teams.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
* AVING NEWS uses AI-assisted tools in its editorial process.
